public_body: Whitman-Hanson Regional School District School Committee
overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the June 18 discussion of the Student Outreach Coordinator was unanticipated, and the other allegations (G.L. c. 71 § 38M, the chair's authority, and adding requested topics) were declined as outside the OML.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the chair violated G.L. c. 71, § 38M in appointing herself Student Outreach Coordinator.
allegations.key_passage: The allegations that Chair Stafford violated G.L. c. 71, § 38M, appointed herself Student Outreach Coordinator without authority to do so, and did not add appointment of a Student Outreach Coordinator to a meeting notice despite the Complainant’s request that she do so, even if true, would not constitute violations of the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the chair appointed herself Student Outreach Coordinator without authority to do so.
allegations.key_passage: Finally, the Open Meeting Law does not address a public body chair’s authority to appoint themselves as Student Outreach Coordinator.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the chair refused the complainant's request to add the Student Outreach Coordinator appointment to a meeting notice.
allegations.key_passage: Furthermore, the Open Meeting Law does not require that a public body add requested topics to its meeting notices.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the committee discussed the Student Outreach Coordinator appointment at its June 18 meeting though it was not on the posted notice.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Committee did not violate the Open Meeting Law as alleged where discussion of the Student Outreach Coordinator was unanticipated.
